scripts.php: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ini = php --ini | Select-String 'Loaded Configuration File' | ForEach-Object { ($_ -split ': ')[1].Trim() }; (Get-Content $ini) -replace ';extension=pdo_pgsql','extension=pdo_pgsql' -replace ';extension=pgsql','extension=pgsql' | Set-Content $ini"
scripts.frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run start
scripts.backend: cd backend && composer install && npm run php && php artisan optimize:clear && php artisan serve
